long_biography.plain_text:
At 20, Nicolini joined his relatives' established pasta, animal-feed and milling concerns, eventually directing Nicovita. Twelve years later, he stepped away and acquired a 150-hectare property the family organization had largely abandoned. There he established Sociedad Agrícola Virú in 1994 and began with white asparagus.

Reliance on trading intermediaries limited the new operation, prompting Nicolini to build a cannery and deal more directly with customers. That move opened a path beyond asparagus to artichokes, fruit, frozen products and other processed lines. European sales companies extended its commercial reach. Nicolini remains in senior stewardship of the enterprise he created, with Yoselyn Malamud handling chief-executive responsibilities.

Twelve years later, he stepped away and acquired a 150-hectare property the family organization had largely abandoned. There he established Sociedad Agrícola Virú in 1994 and began with white asparagus.

Reliance on trading intermediaries limited the new operation, prompting Nicolini to build a cannery and deal more directly with customers. That move opened a path beyond asparagus to artichokes, fruit, frozen products and other processed lines. European sales companies extended its commercial reach. Nicolini remains in senior stewardship of the enterprise he created, with Yoselyn Malamud handling chief-executive responsibilities.
